keyLimits.en: No public pricing; access via demo request and sales quote, priced per module chosen

cautions.en: The platform is sold as a set of separate modules (consent, privacy ops, AI governance, third-party risk); the overall bill depends on which modules are licensed.

capabilities.en: Universal consent and preference management across websites, mobile apps, OTT and connected TVs
Privacy operations automation with data flow visibility, asset classification and incident management
AI governance tooling embedding compliance controls across the AI lifecycle
Third-party risk management automating the vendor lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding

limitations.en: No self-serve pricing; every deployment requires a sales-led quote and demo
Capability set is split across many separate modules, so a small team likely needs several to cover full privacy/risk needs

reason.en: Competing compliance automation platform covering overlapping risk and trust workflows
Competing compliance and third-party risk automation platform

missingAlternatives.name: TrustArc
missingAlternatives.reason: Direct privacy and consent management competitor, not in the catalogue

unknowns: No pricing figures published anywhere on the site; specific named integrations not listed beyond a generic mention of 'native integrations'
